experiments.experiment_label: αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR in situ CAR-M treatment for liver fibrosis
experiments.experiment_anchor_quote: In this study, we explored a pioneering therapeutic approach leveraging CD163 antibody-conjugated liposomal nanoparticles (LNPs) encapsulating FAP-specific chimeric antigen receptor macrophage (CAR-M) mRNA (αCD163/LNP-FAPCAR).
experiments.payload_or_treatment_mention: FAP-specific chimeric antigen receptor macrophage (CAR-M) mRNA
experiments.therapeutic_target_mention: FAP (fibroblast activation protein) on activated HSCs
experiments.distinctness_reason: Only one experiment is described; no variation in treatment, model, dose, route, or timepoint is reported. Sentences S05-S08 directly describe the experimental approach and results.
